Name: Portrait-Accurate Alex Sprite
Author: Rareismyname
Description:
[size=3][b]—————————
[/b]
[b]IMPORTANT.[/b][/size]

The sprites, the images and the (incredible) design all belong to [b]sallychan, [/b]and their accounts will be linked below. As for myself, I only made their mod available for Content Patcher as theirs was sadly outdated, and I also added the beach sprites as well.

I asked for their permission to do it beforehand and upload it here and they agreed. [size=1]Thank you so much![/size]

| [url=http://sallychanscraps.tumblr.com]Tumblr[/url] | [url=http://twitter.com/sallychanscraps?lang=es]Twitter[/url] |

[b]—————[b]—————[b]—[/b][/b][/b]

[size=2]And now, to the description of the mod, quoting the original creator’s message:[/size]

[quote]Alex's sprite always bugged me a bit because he talks so often about tanning and being tan, and his portrait has a much darker complexion in comparison. His hair is also really combed and neat looking in his sprite, unlike his spiky haired portrait. So I edited his sprite sheet to match his portrait better, with a tan, spiky gelled hair, and (as a bonus) those rippling muscles![/quote]
[b][b]—————[b]—————[b]—[/b][/b][/b]
[/b]
[size=3][b]How to install and use:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI and ContentPatcher.
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Extract it and drag the folder “[CP] Portrait-Accurate Alex Sprite” to your Mods folder.
[*]Launch the game and find Alex!
[*] Done!
[/list][/size]
[b]———————————[/b]

And that's it! In case of any issues, please let me know!
